releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.9 — Mac 紧凑 THD 与补偿提速
releases.body:
# Mac RC9：紧凑 THD 显示与补偿提速

Apple Silicon macOS **2.1.0-rc.9（build 7）**，macOS 27.0 及以上，使用已有 F4 2.2.0 固件。

在 Mac 软件中点击 **Check updates → Update software** 更新。

- 移除额外补偿波形和进度区域；THD 直接显示在 Compensation 按钮上，不显示 ON 字样。
- 蓝色按钮表示开启。阶段、基波、修正次数和错误放在悬停提示及底部状态栏；停止或错误后清除旧 THD。
- Applied 摘要显示实际上传的补偿电压表峰值及 Compensated 波形。
- 自动跳过小于基波 0.1% 的受控谐波探测；若后续增长则追加辨识。
- 更大的初始修正步长配合自动回退和限幅。稳定等待、STOP 确认、电压/原始电流保护及看门狗保留。

141 项 Qt 测试、七种仿真通过。同一自动仿真从 5 次探测、4 次修正减少到 2 次探测、3 次修正，THD 达到 0.76%；仿真不代表实机速度或收敛保证。新版尚待实机验证。

本地 ad-hoc 应用签名和 Ed25519 更新签名，未 Apple 公证。此 release 提供 Mac 软件；无需本次固件更新，Windows 保持已有 RC7。

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.8 — Mac 一键自动波形补偿
releases.body:
# Mac RC8：一键自动电流波形补偿

Apple Silicon macOS 软件 **2.1.0-rc.8（build 6）**，要求 macOS 27.0 及以上，配套已有 F4 2.2.0 固件。

## 通过软件更新

在现有 Mac RC4/RC5/RC6/RC7 中点击 **Check updates → Update software**，通过签名增量包或完整包更新并重新启动。首次安装可下载本 release 的 DMG。

主窗口新增 **Compensation ON/OFF**。ON 后点击 Start，系统自动检查固件、确认停止、测零点和基线，确定电流目标并辨识修正；不需要填写电流目标、辨识扰动、学习系数等补偿参数。OFF 使用普通励磁。运行时关闭补偿会停止并恢复普通配置，保持停止。

主窗口显示补偿阶段、电流基波、THD、修正次数及实测/目标波形。达到目标后保持补偿输出并可录制；主窗口 Stop 和退出软件均会确认停止、恢复普通模式。

自动模式以 THD 和幅值误差各低于 1% 为目标，最多 24 次修正；受电压余量、噪声或负载条件限制时会明确报告未达目标或停止。当前是分轮测量和 DAC 波形更新，达到目标后保持波形。

## 范围与验证

- 自动初始电压 0.1–15 Vpeak、频率 1–100 Hz，Sine / Continuous 模式。
- 自定义电压表上限 16 Vpeak；此仪器的原始电流采样上限 0.500 Vpeak，不自动放宽。采样电压不是安培。
- 140 项 Qt 测试与六种仿真通过。新无参数自动模式尚待实机验证；仿真效果不代表真实试样。
- 本地 ad-hoc 应用签名及 Ed25519 更新签名，未 Apple 公证。
- 此 release 提供 Mac 软件；Windows 继续使用已有 RC7。

更新软件不会自动烧写固件。已有 F4 2.2.0 无需重新烧写。

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.7 — 波形补偿与 RC6 回退
releases.body:
# RC7：波形补偿测试功能与 RC6 回退

Windows Qt 软件 **2.1.0-rc.7**，STM32F407 固件 **2.2.0**。

## 通过软件更新

1. 在 RC6 中点击 **Check updates → Update software** 安装 RC7。
2. 启动 RC7、连接仪器，再点击 **Check updates → Update firmware** 安装配套 2.2.0 固件。
3. 主窗口点击 **Waveform Compensation**，设置限值后点击 **Identify and compensate**。参数单位为电流通道采样电压 Vpeak，尚未标定为安培。

## 回退到 RC6

Windows RC7 的 **Check updates** 窗口新增 **Revert to RC6 (software + firmware)** 按钮。保持仪器连接，点击按钮并确认；先恢复 RC6 固件 2.1.1，验证重启及版本后下载并安装 RC6 软件 2.1.0-rc.6。两份文件会匹配第一稳定版留档的固定 SHA-256。若仪器不兼容、未连接或 RC6 发布信息未读取成功，按钮禁用。

取消 RC6 软件安装后可再次点击回退按钮继续。回退后若提示 RC7 更新，可关闭提示继续使用 RC6。原 RC6 发布与附件保留。

## 验证和范围

- 128 项 Qt 测试通过，3 项网络或平台专用用例在本地回归中跳过；新增共享串口、恢复停机、固定 RC6 降级许可、回退按钮及取消流程测试。
- 固件主机测试 O0/O3 通过，4 项 Python 固件包测试通过；Keil 编译 0 错误，3 个原 HAL 警告。
- 仿真正常收敛，并验证旧固件、超时、CRC 错误和电流越限停止。
- **尚未上机验证，不保证特殊磁性材料一定收敛。** 补偿期间暂停普通励磁控制；关闭补偿窗口停止输出并恢复普通模式。
- 本次 Qt 安装包提供 Windows 与 Apple Silicon macOS 版本。macOS 包要求 macOS 27.0 及以上。

附件包括 Windows 安装包与校验文件、USB 固件包与清单、ST-Link factory HEX 和联调说明。

## RC7 安装包替换说明

新增界面统一为英文，版本号仍为 2.1.0-rc.7。已安装此前 RC7 的用户请下载当前安装包覆盖安装；RC6 用户可继续使用软件内更新。固件 2.2.0 不变，已安装该固件无需重刷。


## macOS RC7 与软件内更新

Apple Silicon Mac 软件 **2.1.0-rc.7**（build 4），要求 **macOS 27.0 及以上**。已有带原生更新器的 Mac RC4/RC5/RC6 可点击 **Check updates → Update software** 下载签名增量包（或完整包）、安装并自动重启。首次安装或旧版没有更新入口时，下载 `MBN-Instrument-macOS-arm64.dmg`，拖入 Applications 后运行。

Mac 版包含相同的 Waveform Compensation，配套 F4 固件 2.2.0。130 项 Qt 测试与五种补偿仿真通过，原生启动验证通过；尚未连接真实仪器验证。Mac 使用本地 ad-hoc 应用签名及 Ed25519 更新签名，未 Apple 公证。RC6 软件与固件一键回退按钮仅适用于 Windows。

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.17 — extended compensation observation (macOS)
releases.body:
RC17 extends compensation settling and nonconvergence observation so slow responses are not stopped prematurely. Stalled detection now requires eight distinct corrections without max(0.005 percentage point, 1% of best error) improvement and at least 12 seconds of correction observation. Up to 24 corrections are permitted; after the budget is reached, the response is observed without increasing correction count until the minimum window expires. Automatic total deadlines have a 30-second floor and use min(180 s, max(30 s, 36 × (4/f + 0.3 s))).

Cycle settling now allows max(12 cycles, 3 seconds × frequency); e.g. 15 Hz gets 45 cycles rather than 12. Stable/verified runs still finish immediately and learned waveform reuse remains fast. Current trips, ADC faults, DC protections, waveform limits and STOP retain immediate protection. Live THD and stable-load automatic re-compensation remain enabled.

Use Update software. Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+; no firmware update or hardware excitation.

## Windows x64 RC17

Windows now includes the same RC17 Qt application features: automatic waveform compensation, low-frequency operation, learned waveform reuse, current in amperes, live THD and stable-load re-compensation, plus the extended settling and convergence observation policy described above.

Installer and portable ZIP include Qt runtimes and ST-Link tools. Validation: six QtTest suites, 148 passed, zero failures, five optional/platform-specific cases skipped; automatic compensation simulation finished at 0.56% THD; version and startup checks passed. Physical hardware excitation and flashing were not performed.

Existing Windows users can use Check updates / Update software. No firmware update is required for this desktop release.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.16 — live THD and adaptive compensation (macOS)
releases.body:
RC16 increases the initial automatic learning gain from 0.4 to the controller-supported 0.5, retaining bounded steps, voltage/current limits and gain reduction after worsening response. Existing learned-waveform reuse remains the fastest route for repeated settings.

Automatic compensation stops early when four distinct corrections fail to improve the maximum THD/amplitude error by at least max(0.01 percentage point, 2% of the best error), or when voltage bounds leave no feasible correction. The cap is reduced from 24 to 12 corrections. Acquisition-aware deadlines are shortened to max(8 s, 18 × (4/f + 0.3 s)), capped at 90 s. Low frequencies can still take longer than five seconds.

Failure stops output, clears the waiting overlay/green state and persistently displays Compensation Unavailable, with the reason in the tooltip/status bar. Automatic failure no longer silently holds a nonconverged best waveform. Manual diagnostic behavior is retained. Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+, signed Update software channel; no firmware change or hardware excitation.

While compensated output is held, THD is measured continuously from complete current cycles and the button updates up to four times per second. Previously verified cycle stability seeds monitoring to avoid a false transition after convergence. Stable changes (THD >1.2% or amplitude change >3%) trigger automatic zero/baseline verification and compensation without a button press. Unstable waveforms wait; DC offset above 10% for two cycles stops. Existing firmware/current/watchdog protections remain active. Recording, countdown and finalization defer output changes. STOP/OFF cancel queued automatic restarts.

Tests include live load change followed by automatic re-compensation, stopped cancellation, recording guard and a plant that ceases responding to corrections. Newly discovered harmonics reset progress tracking so improving responses are not falsely treated as stalled.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.15 — calibrated current display in amperes (macOS)
releases.body:
RC15 displays excitation current in amperes using the supplied 0.1 ohm shunt and equal R51/R52 non-inverting amplifier resistors: gain 2, I = I_AD / (0.1 × 2) = 5 × I_AD A/V. Current time traces, current-envelope axis, automatic/manual ranges and current trigger-line placement use the same conversion. Waveform axes include the measured AC peak; compensation information displays fundamental Apeak. Compensation CSV retains its voltage columns and adds current_A/target_A.

ADC acquisition, raw recording format, trigger input voltage, compensation model/cache and physical trip thresholds retain sense-voltage units. No firmware change is required. Tests verify positive/negative current conversion, actual chart data, envelope keys, trigger lines, manual units and compensation readout.

Use Update software through the signed macos-updates channel. Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+. No instrument was energized.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.14 — compensation waiting animation (macOS)
releases.body:
RC14 adds a plot-only compensation waiting overlay: a softly blurred snapshot of the previous charts, a translucent wash, Compensating text and an animated rotating ring. It fades in/out over 180 ms and follows plot-area resizing. Both BH and MBN tabs are covered; excitation/STOP/parameter controls remain accessible. The overlay persists across parameter restarts and disappears on ready/STOP/error/OFF. It does not alter acquisition, output or compensation behavior.

Control/animation/cleanup tests passed and the generated UI screenshot was visually checked. Use Update software through the signed macos-updates channel. Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+. No firmware update is required and no instrument was energized.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.13 — learned compensation and stable transitions (macOS)
releases.body:
RC13 retains the previous chart during compensation/restart and clearly labels it as the previous waveform. Only verified/held output resumes live plotting, reducing repeated zero/probe flashes. Internal switch status does not alternate the main badge; STOP and error states remain visible. Physical output still follows firmware STOP/ramp and validated upload/start sequencing.

Converged automatic waveforms are stored by USB serial identity, exact firmware version, frequency, requested amplitude and voltage limit. Repeated settings load the learned waveform and verify measured THD, amplitude and DC before accepting it. Load mismatch triggers fresh learning; excess current stops normally. Sensor-zero changes, invalid/expired profiles and voltage bounds prevent reuse. Profiles persist across application restarts, expire after seven days and are capped at 64 entries. Missing USB serial identity disables reuse.

Cycle-based settling now applies to all automatic frequencies: two consecutive stable changes plus one measured cycle, with a 12-cycle instability stop. Logs show time including preparation. Simulation at 15 Hz demonstrated cold learning around 2.77 s, cross-process reuse around 1.01 s, and changed-load fallback around 3.16 s. These are simulator timings, not hardware guarantees; first learning and low frequencies may exceed five seconds.

Use Update software through the signed macos-updates channel. Existing F4 2.2.1 supports the 18 Vpeak compensation limit; no new firmware is required. Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+. No instrument was energized.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.12 — 18 Vpeak compensation / 20 Vpeak firmware
releases.body:
RC12 sets the normal excitation and F4 firmware hard limit to 20 Vpeak, and automatic compensation to 18 Vpeak maximum (both requested amplitude and actual waveform peak). The main amplitude field caps at 18 when Compensation is enabled and returns to 20 when disabled. Enabling compensation above 18 clamps the requested value to 18. Identification probes choose a bounded direction/size at the ceiling.

F4 firmware 2.2.1 is required for compensation above 16 and normal output above 16. RC12 also supports existing 2.2.0 firmware with its 16 Vpeak limit. The new firmware retains voltage calibration and legacy custom-wave protocol scaling, and widens intermediate arithmetic to prevent overflow above 16. Firmware current trips, watchdog, STOP and waveform validation remain enabled. At the voltage ceiling there may be insufficient correction headroom to reach the THD goal.

Update software to RC12, then use Update firmware to install F4 2.2.1. USB update package, first-install factory HEX and checksums are attached. No instrument was flashed or energized during this release work; 20 Vpeak firmware scaling and 16/18 Vpeak compensation were verified through host tests/simulation. Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.11 — automatic compensation controls (macOS)
releases.body:
RC11 allows frequency and amplitude editing while automatic compensation is enabled. Changes are debounced for 700 ms, then confirmed STOP/restoration precedes a fresh automatic run using the latest requested parameters. Apply settings starts that transition immediately. STOP, compensation OFF, quitting or failed restoration cancel the restart. Recording keeps these settings locked.

The Compensation button turns green only when the measured THD and amplitude error meet the goal; a best-waveform fallback is not green. Parameter edits clear the previous THD and green state.

Apple Silicon/macOS 27.0+. Install with Update software through the signed macos-updates channel. No firmware change is needed.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.10 — faster low-frequency compensation (macOS)
releases.body:
RC10 accelerates automatic low-frequency current compensation and keeps the compact THD button.

At 1–5 Hz, settling is measured cycle by cycle: two consecutive stable changes followed by one averaged cycle. Stable measurements need about 4 cycles rather than 16; unstable responses stop after 12 settling cycles. Corrections use identified harmonic response, learning gain 0.4 and a voltage-dependent bounded step. Current trips, voltage limits and STOP remain active. No firmware update is required for existing F4 2.2.0 devices.

Apple Silicon, macOS 27.0+. Use Update software through the signed macos-updates channel. The DMG is for first installation.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.6 — Windows, macOS and USB Firmware Update
releases.body:
macOS rc.6 and F4 firmware USB update release.

- Fixes the Qt crash during firmware update completion: a modal progress update could process completion events that closed the dialog before it was accessed again.
- Adds **Reinstall firmware** over USB when the installed and published firmware versions match. Newer firmware still uses **Update firmware**; bootloader/capacity checks remain enforced.
- The USB firmware action is available alongside ST-Link installation. Only the instrument restarts after flashing; the desktop application stays open.
- macOS application: **2.1.0-rc.6**, Sparkle build **3**. The signed macOS update channel supports automatic installation and incremental updates from prior builds.
- Included F4 USB firmware: **2.1.1**; requires USB bootloader **1.0.0** installed previously through ST-Link. Firmware assets are unchanged from the earlier rc.6 firmware release.

Use **Check Updates → Update software** in rc.5 to install the desktop fix. Afterward, **Check Updates → Update firmware / Reinstall firmware** installs the published firmware through USB.

Validation: 18 firmware updater tests, including the modal completion crash regression and same-version reinstall selection; 30 control-flow tests (two optional live-network tests skipped); macOS build, deployed bundle signing and DMG verification. Physical USB reflashing remains to be confirmed on the instrument.

Windows x64 2.1.0-rc.6 is now available alongside the macOS application and F4 USB firmware.

## Windows x64 rc.6

- Includes the firmware-update completion crash fix and USB firmware reinstallation when installed/published versions match. USB and ST-Link actions are offered together; firmware installation restarts the instrument while keeping the desktop application open.
- Includes Qt runtimes, ST-Link 1.8.0 tools, libusb, chip definitions and licenses. Install the ST-Link USB driver separately from https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stsw-link009.html.
- Windows validation: six QtTest suites, 124 passed, 0 failed. The two Windows live network cases were then run successfully: rc.6 update selection and public installer download/checksum verification passed. The POSIX-only mock CLI fixture remains skipped. The rc.6 published 2.1.1 firmware package passed package validation. Deployed app version is 2.1.0-rc.6; installer version is 2.1.0.6; bundled ST-Link tools report 1.8.0.
- Physical USB/ST-Link programming remains unverified in this Windows run.

Download center: https://man-mbn.github.io/MBN-Instrument-Releases/

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.5 — Windows and macOS ST-Link Preview
releases.body:
Download center: https://man-mbn.github.io/MBN-Instrument-Releases/

macOS preview 2.1.0-rc.5 — ST-Link firmware installation

Apple Silicon (arm64); requires macOS 27.0 or newer. Development ad-hoc signature; not Apple notarized.

- Interactive Check Updates detects a connected ST-Link target and offers Install firmware via ST-Link, in preference to USB firmware installation when a supported probe and release are available.
- Downloads the latest matching factory HEX directly from GitHub, verifies SHA-256, Intel HEX bounds/checksums and factory image metadata before writing.
- Pins the probe serial, requires supported STM32F405/F407 chip family with 1 MB flash, reads every programmed segment back for byte comparison, then resets the target.
- Recording, pending instrument commands and concurrent update operations prevent installation. A connected instrument must confirm STOP. Checking updates alone never writes firmware.
- Includes stlink 1.8.0, libusb, chip definitions and licenses; no Homebrew installation needed on macOS.
- Signed Sparkle rc.4-to-rc.5 delta upgrade; no dragging after the first installation. Windows x64 rc.5 is now available in MBN-Instrument-Setup.exe with its SHA-256 sidecar.

The attached STM32F407VG-MBN 2.1.0 development factory HEX installs the USB bootloader and application. The .mbnfw package is for boards already running a compatible USB bootloader. The probe chip ID cannot identify the board design: confirm the attached board is the intended MBN STM32F407VG. ST-Link cannot reliably report the version of arbitrary legacy firmware, so the app explicitly offers installation/reinstallation rather than claiming the board is current.

Validation: mocked programming/readback/error cases, generated firmware/package checks, real signed rc.4-to-rc.5 delta reconstruction and native app/tool/feed checks passed. Physical ST-Link/USB programming of this development firmware remains unverified. Use a bench setup with external excitation stopped and keep board power/SWD connected. The unsigned development firmware provides integrity checks, not publisher signature authentication. Settings flash above 0x080C0000 is excluded from the factory HEX and programming bounds.

## Windows x64 rc.5

- Includes the rc.5 ST-Link firmware installation flow, release manifest and SHA-256 validation, bounded Intel HEX checks, pinned probe selection and byte-for-byte readback before reset.
- Bundles official ST-Link 1.8.0 x64 tools, libusb 1.0.29, relocated chip definitions and licenses. A compatible Windows USB driver for the probe must be installed separately.
- Includes the existing USB firmware updater and verified Windows software updater. Use Check Updates in older Windows versions to install rc.5.
- Windows validation: 119 QtTest cases passed, no failures; one POSIX-only mock fixture remains skipped. The two live Windows network checks were then run successfully, verifying rc.5 update selection and the public installer download against its SHA-256 sidecar. Generated factory HEX and firmware package checks passed. Deployed application reports 2.1.0-rc.5; installer version is 2.1.0.5. Both bundled native CLI tools start and no-probe detection succeeds.
- Physical ST-Link/USB programming remains unverified. No connected board was programmed during Windows validation.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.4 — macOS Preview
releases.body:
macOS preview release: 2.1.0-rc.4

- Apple Silicon (arm64); requires macOS 27.0 or newer for this build.
- Bundled Qt runtime and application icon.
- Check Updates checks host software and instrument firmware separately.
- Signed Sparkle incremental software updates with full-package fallback, automatic replacement and relaunch after the instrument safely stops. First installation/migration uses the DMG.
- USB firmware-update integration is included; the complete update sequence on a physical STM32 board has not yet been verified. This release does not contain a new firmware image.

Development build: ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized. macOS Gatekeeper may display a security warning.

Open the DMG, install MBN_Instrument_Mac.app in Applications, eject the image and launch the installed app. Subsequent supported software updates install from within the app without dragging.

Windows rc.4 has not been built or published. Existing Windows rc.3 assets remain available in their original release.

releases.name: MBN Instrument v2.1.0-rc.1
releases.body:
Initial automatic-update release for the Qt/F4 application.

- Checks this public repository automatically at startup and manually from Help > Check for updates.
- Downloads over Windows HTTPS and verifies the installer SHA-256 before launching it.
- Uses the existing safe-close path to stop F4 excitation before updating.
- Installs per-user under Local AppData; administrator rights are not required.
- F4 firmware is not included and was not changed.

Note: this installer is not yet code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning on first download.

releases.name: macOS signed update channel
releases.body:
Signed macOS update channel

Latest build: 2 (2.1.0-rc.5), Apple Silicon, minimum macOS 27.0. The signed feed includes exact full ZIPs for builds 1 and 2, plus the verified rc.4-to-rc.5 delta. Build 1 assets remain immutable and available.

For first installation use the DMG in v2.1.0-rc.5. For ST-Link factory HEX/USB firmware packages and bench-test limitations, see that release. This channel contains no Windows installer and is not the repository Latest release.
